trap.label: look forward to + -ing
trap.wrong: I look forward to meet you.
trap.right: I look forward to meeting you.
trap.why: Em português “aguardo encontrá-lo” usa infinitivo. Em inglês, to em look forward to é preposição e vem seguida de -ing ou substantivo.

mcq.q: In a formal email, which ending fits?
opts: I look forward to hearing from you.
I look forward to the class.

fix.wrong: She looks forward to see them.
fix.right: She looks forward to seeing them.
We look forward to the party.

fix.wrong: I look forward to hear from you soon.
fix.right: I look forward to hearing from you soon.

rewrite.prompt: Reescreva: “I will see you. I am excited.” (look forward)
rewrite.answer: I look forward to seeing you.

rewrite.prompt: Reescreva com they: “I look forward to the trip.”
rewrite.answer: They look forward to the trip.

rewrite.prompt: Reescreva com we e meeting: “I look forward to meeting you.”
rewrite.answer: We look forward to meeting you.
